### McGraw Hill, Inc. to Host Investor Day on November 18, 2026


November 10, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/964897494/files/doc_news/McGraw-Hill-Inc--to-Host-Investor-Day-on-November-18-2026-7b297afe7-2026.pdf)


COLUMBUS, Ohio--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[McGraw Hill, Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54638234&newsitemid=20261110993974&lan=en-US&anchor=McGraw+Hill%2C+Inc&index=1&md5=2dd79f5f1777bc7c1d34e7ed12798a26) . (NYSE: MH; the “Company”), a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, will host an Investor Day on Wednesday, November 18, 2026 in New York City. The event will be live and have a webcast option and will begin at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time and conclude at approximately 12:30 p.m. Eastern Time.


The event will be hosted by Philip Moyer, President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Company’s Board of Directors; Dave Cortese, Executive Vice President, Chief Digital Information Officer; Bob Sallmann, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer; Robin Lucas, President, Higher Education; Jana Thompson, President, K-12; as well as other members of the Company’s executive leadership team.


Executives will discuss the Company’s strategic priorities, growth initiatives, technology roadmap and financial framework. The event will also feature interactive product demonstrations and discussions with educators, and it will conclude with a live question and answer session.


Due to limited seating capacity, in-person attendance is invite-only with prior registration required. To access the live webcast, please register at[https://mheducation2026investorday.q4ir.com/home/default.aspx](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmheducation2026investorday.q4ir.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54638234&newsitemid=20261110993974&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fmheducation2026investorday.q4ir.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&index=2&md5=8cb90d664b50af96ec3d091d599c8939) .


To view a replay of the event, visit the Company’s Investor Relations website at[https://investors.mheducation.com/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.mheducation.com%2F&esheet=54638234&newsitemid=20261110993974&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.mheducation.com%2F&index=3&md5=5e97e74561e7014147ad4762799a560a) .


**McGraw Hill, Inc.**


McGraw Hill, Inc. (NYSE: MH) is a leading global provider of education solutions for preK-12, higher education and professional learning, supporting the evolving needs of millions of educators and students around the world. We provide trusted, high-quality content and personalized learning experiences that use data, technology and learning science to help students progress towards their goals. Through our commitment to fostering a culture of innovation and belonging, we are dedicated to improving outcomes and access to education for all. We have over 30 offices across North America, Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East and South America, and make our learning solutions available in more than 80 languages.
